description: This file defines a Java interface 'PocketRepository' that extends JPA repository interfaces for managing 'Pocket' entities. It includes a custom query method to find a pocket's ID by 'appUserId'.

classes.name: PocketRepository
classes.description: A repository interface for 'Pocket' entities with custom query capabilities.

methods.name: findByAppUserId
methods.description: Executes a query to retrieve the ID of a 'Pocket' associated with a given 'appUserId'.
